comment: Index order is not panel order: the enum puts the lower bank's buttons and outputs first (BUTTON2 and BUTTON2_OUT, indices 0 to 6) and the upper bank's second, while the inputs run the other way round (INS1, indices 0 to 6, is the upper bank). The tags are written from the widget at src/MentalRadioButtons.cpp:146-158. The lower bank's jacks are read through the upper bank's trigger objects: src/MentalRadioButtons.cpp:120 calls button_triggers[i].process on the INS2 voltage where button2_triggers[i] was plainly meant, so a gate patched to a lower-bank jack shares its trigger state with the upper-bank button and jack at the same number and the two interfere. In every case here a button and a jack are fed to one trigger inside a single || expression, which hands the trigger two different values per sample and makes a steady high voltage re-fire on every sample; that is why the lines say a gate holds the selection rather than firing once.
